plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Fix long delay when skipping tracks — increased concurrent prefetch from 1 to 2 so skipped-to tracks download in parallel with background prefetch. Fix queue showing YouTube IDs instead of track titles by triggering background metadata fetch for uncached tracks.
